description: Fetch DEV.to community trends from the /trending page. This is a browser-only path; no public API endpoint exposes the AI-generated trend summaries. Returns trend titles, post counts, analysis summaries, key discussion areas, cover images, and the list of available filter tags. Optionally filter by --tag.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Optional trend tag slug (without the # prefix). Must be one of the filter tags shown on the /trending page. If omitted, all trends are returned.
